import { Controller, Injectable, Module, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import {
  EventEmitter2,
  EventEmitterModule,
  OnEvent as NestOnEvent,
} from '@nestjs/event-emitter';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Entity, Repository } from 'typeorm';

const ORDER_CREATED = 'order.created';
enum DomainEvents {
  Audited = 'order.audited',
}
export const ORDER_SYMBOL: unique symbol = Symbol('order.symbol');
const HANDLED_EVENTS = [ORDER_CREATED, DomainEvents.Audited] as const;
let dynamicEvent = 'runtime.event';
const DYNAMIC_OPTIONS = getRuntimeOptions();

declare function getRuntimeOptions(): unknown;

@Entity('order_audit')
class OrderAudit {}

@Injectable()
class OrderAuditWriter {
  constructor(@InjectRepository(OrderAudit) private readonly repository: Repository<OrderAudit>) {}

  writeCreated(): void {
    void this.repository.save({ marker: 'created' });
  }
}

@Injectable()
class OrderAuditForwarder {
  constructor(private readonly writer: OrderAuditWriter) {}

  forwardCreated(): void {
    this.writer.writeCreated();
  }
}

@Injectable()
class OrderHandlers {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(OrderAudit) private readonly repository: Repository<OrderAudit>,
    private readonly events: EventEmitter2,
    private readonly forwarder: OrderAuditForwarder,
  ) {}

  @NestOnEvent(ORDER_CREATED)
  handleCreated(): void {
    this.forwarder.forwardCreated();
  }

  @NestOnEvent(HANDLED_EVENTS)
  audit(): void {
    void this.repository.save({ marker: 'audit' });
  }

  @NestOnEvent(ORDER_SYMBOL, { async: true })
  handleSymbol(): void {
    void this.repository.save({ marker: 'symbol' });
  }

  @NestOnEvent('cycle.a')
  cycleA(): void {
    this.events.emit('cycle.b');
  }

  @NestOnEvent('cycle.b')
  cycleB(): void {
    this.events.emit('cycle.a');
  }

  @NestOnEvent('order.*')
  wildcardDeferred(): void {}
}

@Injectable()
class OrphanHandler {
  constructor(@InjectRepository(OrderAudit) private readonly repository: Repository<OrderAudit>) {}

  @NestOnEvent(ORDER_CREATED)
  orphan(): void {
    void this.repository.save({ marker: 'orphan' });
  }
}

@Injectable()
class UnreachableHandler {
  constructor(@InjectRepository(OrderAudit) private readonly repository: Repository<OrderAudit>) {}

  @NestOnEvent(ORDER_CREATED)
  unreachable(): void {
    void this.repository.save({ marker: 'unreachable' });
  }
}

@Module({ providers: [UnreachableHandler] })
class UnreachableModule {}

@Controller('events')
class EventsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly events: EventEmitter2,
    @InjectRepository(OrderAudit) private readonly repository: Repository<OrderAudit>,
  ) {}

  @Post('create')
  create(): void {
    void this.repository.save({ marker: 'synchronous' });
    this.events.emit(ORDER_CREATED, { secret: 'payload-secret-must-not-appear' });
  }

  @Post('async')
  asyncEvent(): Promise<unknown[]> {
    return this.events.emitAsync(DomainEvents.Audited, { token: 'async-secret' });
  }

  @Post('symbol')
  symbol(): void {
    this.events.emit(ORDER_SYMBOL);
  }

  @Post('dynamic')
  dynamic(): void {
    this.events.emit(dynamicEvent);
  }

  @Post('cycle')
  cycle(): void {
    this.events.emit('cycle.a');
  }

  @Post('state-limit')
  stateLimit(): void {
    this.events.emit('state.limit');
  }

  callbackAndManualListener(): void {
    [1].forEach(() => this.events.emit('callback.event'));
    this.events.on('manual.listener', () => undefined);
  }
}

@Injectable()
class AliasPublisher {
  private readonly bus: EventEmitter2;

  constructor(events: EventEmitter2) {
    this.bus = events;
  }

  publish(): void {
    this.bus.emit('alias.published');
  }
}

@Injectable()
class DynamicConfigHandler {
  @NestOnEvent('dynamic.config')
  handle(): void {}
}

@Injectable()
class StateLimitHandlers {
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle01(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle02(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle03(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle04(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle05(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle06(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle07(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle08(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle09(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle10(): void {}
  @NestOnEvent('state.limit') handle11(): void {}
}

@Module({
  imports: [EventEmitterModule.forRoot({ wildcard: false })],
  controllers: [EventsController],
  providers: [
    OrderHandlers,
    OrderAuditWriter,
    OrderAuditForwarder,
    AliasPublisher,
    StateLimitHandlers,
  ],
})
class AppModule {}

@Module({
  imports: [EventEmitterModule.forRoot(DYNAMIC_OPTIONS)],
  providers: [DynamicConfigHandler],
})
class DynamicAppModule {}

async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
  await NestFactory.create(AppModule);
  await NestFactory.create(DynamicAppModule);
}

function OnEvent(_event: string): MethodDecorator {
  return () => undefined;
}
class EventEmitter2Lookalike {
  emit(_event: string): void {}
}

@Injectable()
class Lookalikes {
  constructor(private readonly events: EventEmitter2Lookalike) {}

  @OnEvent(ORDER_CREATED)
  localHandler(): void {}

  localEmit(): void {
    this.events.emit('lookalike.event');
  }
}

@Injectable()
class AmbiguousPublisher {
  constructor(private readonly events: EventEmitter2 | EventEmitter2Lookalike) {}

  publish(): void {
    this.events.emit('ambiguous.event');
  }
}

@Injectable()
class ReassignedPublisher {
  constructor(private events: EventEmitter2) {}

  replace(events: EventEmitter2): void {
    this.events = events;
    this.events.emit('reassigned.event');
  }
}
